title: 12 Best Vegan Restaurants in Cartagena
description: Discover Cartagena's top vegan restaurants, from high-end dining to casual cafes. Explore delicious plant-based cuisine, budget-friendly options, and unique experiences in the historic city.

places.name: Herbívora Cocina Vegetariana
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Chicharrón Vegano' made from mushrooms or their daily rotating 'Menu del Día'.

places.name: Restaurante Vegetariano Govinda's
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The fixed 'Menu del Día' which always has a vegan option, including rice, dal, a vegetable curry, and often a salad.

places.name: Celele Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The vegan tasting menu (reservations essential) for a multi-course exploration of Colombian plant-based flavors.

places.name: Café Stepping Stone
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The Vegan Arepa or the Açaí Bowl, customized with vegan toppings. Don't forget a fresh juice!

places.name: Gokela
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A custom 'Build Your Own' salad or bowl with quinoa, plenty of veggies, chickpeas, and a vinaigrette dressing.

places.name: El Aleph
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The Falafel Plate or the Hummus with warm pita bread, ensuring to specify 'vegan' for any modifications.

places.name: Beiyú Café-Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Tropical Açaí Bowl' or the 'Vegan Tostada' with avocado and fresh vegetables. Ask about their daily vegan special.

places.name: Demente
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask your server for current vegan tapas options; they often have delicious roasted vegetables, patatas bravas (without aioli), or mushroom dishes.

places.name: Pizzeria Aguanile
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A custom vegan pizza: 'Pizza Vegetariana' without cheese, or ask if they have vegan mozzarella, loaded with olives, mushrooms, peppers, and onions.

places.name: Alma Restaurante Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Consult with the server or chef upon arrival to explore the available vegan options or potential off-menu creations for a tailored experience.

places.name: Pepe Kábaro
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A selection of their vegan-friendly tapas like 'Patatas Bravas' (without aioli), grilled vegetables, and often a vibrant salad. Always confirm ingredients.

places.name: Caffé Lunático
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their fresh fruit bowl, avocado toast (confirm no butter), or a vegan sandwich option if available. Pair it with an oat milk latte.
